title: Plyleaf: Free PDF Tools That Never Upload Your Files
description: Make booklets, merge, sign, compress and convert PDFs for free. No account, no ads, and your files stay on your device: every tool runs in the browser.
h1: PDF tools that never upload your files
lede: Booklets, signatures, e-books, compression and 100 more tools. Everything runs in your browser, for free.

why.title: Your files stay with you
why.text: Each tool runs inside the browser tab. Nothing is sent to a server, so there is nothing to delete afterwards and nothing to leak.

why.title: Free without a catch
why.text: No account, no daily limit, no watermark. The code is open, so anyone can check what it does.

why.title: Every page explains itself
why.text: Under each tool: step-by-step instructions, an example of the result and honest notes on what it cannot do.
